text: No boat, no witness, a thousand dinars due today. What would you do?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: a man of Bani Israil borrowed a thousand dinars.
Witnesses? He said: Allah is enough as a witness. A guarantor? Allah is enough as a guarantor. And the lender agreed.
When the day came to repay... he could find no boat.
So he hollowed out a piece of wood, put in the thousand dinars and a letter, and sealed it.
At the sea he said: O Allah, I said You are enough, and he accepted You. I cannot find a boat... so I entrust this to You. And he threw it in.
On the other shore, the lender came out hoping for a boat... and found a piece of wood. He took it home for firewood.
When he cut it open... there was his money, and the letter.
When you can't keep a promise with your own hands... keep it with Allah. He is enough as a witness.
